description: Deterministic custody, identity, acquisition, and freshness gates for private Facebook profile and managed Page messages.

cases.criterion: Facebook inbox, archived, and request thread packets are discovered without reading or returning private message bodies.
Identical provider thread paths remain distinct per exporting profile or Page while a personal owner and organizational Page owner remain separate identities.

The body-free registry distinguishes profile and Page export surfaces, active state, all-time-lookback daily requirements, verified versus unverified recurrence support, and omits private provider IDs.
A ready profile can advance without erasing a pending Page, and each newly materialized Page packet later joins the canonical projection and account views.
The Facebook freshness job runs hourly and at login from the private account registry without embedding account names in its command.
An authenticated Facebook pull is isolated by account-specific prefix, private cache and manifest paths, and Messages-only provider subtrees.
A configured Facebook account refreshes its authenticated Drive cache before importing and reporting body-free status.
Fresh incremental Facebook packets cannot be labeled full history until that exact account has a materialized, explicitly recorded all-time baseline.
The shared Meta Drive discovery path reports a source-neutral pending condition instead of mislabeling Facebook acquisition as Instagram.
